method: Genuine per-pose painted regional crest on existing physical wing/case/robe. NEAREST samples painted mark only; exact original body alpha, nonmark pixels, roots and actions. Six approved holding attachments replayed from painted ink and fixed material fields.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Firstimage is an exact1536x1024 atlas of EXISTING painted2D native HoMM3 mirrorMage PHYSICAL MATERIAL CONTEXT CROPS,8columns8rows, some cells empty. Each crop shows only part of its existing creature, NOT permission to draw/reconstruct cut-off anatomy. Preserve every context at exact original position and size. Secondimage exact official SINGLE-REGION BANDLE CITY crest; thirdimage the approved source-material holding direction and scale. Edit ALL ACTUAL VISIBLE MATERIAL SURFACES as follows: Paint bold opaque IVORY embroidered/painted glyph on actual lower-front ROBE FIELD between belt and hem as reference3. Large clear emblem filling most real cloth field. For the upgraded purple robe REMOVE old competing gold decorative leaf filigree ONLY directly inside this emblem field; give it quiet darkplum backing, keep all outergoldhem/mantle borders. Base keeps olive robe. Respect actual hand/staff/robe folds, rear-turn backcoat and corpse-fold occlusion; NEVER put glyph on skin/face/hair/gear or emptyspace. Correct distinctive shape REQUIRED: central SPIRAL/COIL, TWO separate tall upward CURLING ARMS ending in ROUND DOTS, paired leafsprigs and tapering ROOTSTEM. Keep broad opaque strokes and open negative channels, no tiny leaf-only/flower/diamond/rune/circle. Targetordinary battle crest approximately12-18nativepixels high (usually30-50pixels in these enlarged crop cells), scale proportionally for map/portraitviews. Make central coil and arms separated by clear >=1nativepixel negativechannels after technical downsampling, as reference3. Strong darkgreen-on-ivory or ivory-on-darkfield contrast; minimal weathering INSIDEglyph, not blurred glossy lowcontrast emboss. Same exact region mark across all cells but genuinely paint each physical plane's current pose/angle/occlusion, never always-front-facing floatingstamp. Do not enlarge symbols beyond original material boundaries. Preserve all creature silhouettes/body/actions and every noncrest item/limb/face/equipment exactly. These are classic1999HeroesIII textured painted sprites, not3D/artworkredraw. Transparent background, original1536x1024canvas, every cell position unchanged; no labels/grid/extra figures/watermarks. Empty cells remain empty.
